text:

Thanks for your time earlier and your openness to explaining the context on
some of Sevensense's challenges post-ABB on the safety / system side, as
opposed to the VSLAM angle as I had thought. Here's a short summary to pass
on internally, from which we can set up a further call if there is
sufficient interest.

*What Encord does:*

Encord is a data development platform for teams building computer vision
and multimodal AI. We help teams curate, annotate, evaluate, and manage the
data that feeds perception, SLAM, and decision-making models: across 2D
imagery, 3D point clouds, sensor fusion, and video.

Where we typically help robotics teams:

   - Multi-sensor and 3D annotation (fused camera + LiDAR, linked 2D-3D
   labelling)
   - Curating the long tail of edge cases and failure modes from deployment
   data
   - Model evaluation and validation - surfacing where perception breaks
   down before it hits production
   - Active learning loops to prioritise the most useful data to label next

*Robotics customers:*

Pickle Robot, Dexterity, and other physical AI companies working on
perception, manipulation, and autonomous navigation. Happy to share more
specific case studies if useful.

*Why I thought it might be worth flagging:*

Even with strong internal tooling, AMR teams scaling across new sites and
tightening safety regulations often need a faster loop between fleet data
and model improvements - without displacing the in-house stack. That's
usually where we slot in.

If anyone on the perception, ML, or data infra side wants a 20-minute
technical walkthrough, I'm happy to set it up, and equally happy to just
leave this here as background. No pressure either way.
